Specification: This specification is a small test module intended to check that TLC distinguishes the tuple <<x>> from the scalar x when evaluating function expressions. It defines a set S by set comprehension over singleton tuples built from the numbers 1 through 4, and then states an assumption about a function defined over elements of S and applied at argument 2. The module does not model a transition system, has no state variables or actions, and contains no temporal properties; it is a static expression-level test focused on tuple/function semantics.
